english.title: Leave / park a vehicle / cause a vehicle to wait in excess of the permitted time at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) otherwise than in an emergency

(A)_[left a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(C)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to wait]_

for a period in excess of the permitted time in an area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..), at Southampton Airport where the period of waiting was restricted by a sign
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(3) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
